answer: Identity without cost is inventory. Grading seats are auctioned with time-locked bids, making bulk identity attention unaffordable. A comet of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the shale of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and karst-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Verify once, price forever — the bond, not the ban, does the work.
